name: code-quality-report
title: Auditron Code Quality Report — CrowdStrike Racing About
summary: Review gate failed before Maven: **AUD-HDR-001** prevents the required active About navigation state. Maven budget remains **0/2**.

matrix.detail: 222 XML files parse; namespace/protected-property checks pass
Template mappings, explicit allowlists, numeric style IDs and DAM paths resolve statically
Source/lockfile use Playwright; stale Cypress module coordinates remain in ui.tests/pom.xml

findings.title: Current-page comparison cannot match public navigation URLs
findings.issue: The model returns request.getRequestPath().getResourcePath() (the internal AEM resource path) while seeded URLs are public paths such as /about-us/. isCurrent strips only .html, so /about-us/ cannot equal /content/adlc-crowdstrike/us/en/about-us.
findings.evidence: SiteHeaderModel.java:29,56 and header master .content.xml public URL /about-us/; HTL consumes item.current and model.currentPath.
findings.cause: No resource mapping or public-path normalization occurs before equality comparison.
findings.recommendation: Normalize both values into the same mapped public route (for example ResourceResolver.map(request, resourcePath) or a dedicated normalized request URL) and add unit tests for /about-us/, .html and the internal resource path.

findings.title: Cypress naming remains in Maven metadata
findings.issue: The runner, Docker image, scripts and package lock use Playwright, but artifactId/name/description still state Cypress.
findings.evidence: ui.tests/pom.xml:28-31; no Cypress dependency or source remains under test-module.
findings.recommendation: Rename only descriptive Maven coordinates/text if compatibility permits; otherwise document the compatibility exception in the UI harness evidence.

findings.title: Publish-domain mapping is environment-owned
findings.issue: No source-backed publish hostname is available.
findings.recommendation: Configure the real publish/author domains and verify the Core Page canonical after deployment.

findings.title: Supplied image rights confirmation remains pending
findings.issue: Use rights for supplied images and mirrored logo are owner-owned.
findings.recommendation: Obtain and record rights confirmation before production activation.

blocks.p: Policy mappings resolve to declared Racing Page, container, Teaser and XF policies; each new editable context has an explicit allowlist. The numeric style IDs 20260902001–20260902006 and 20260902011–20260902013 resolve against seeded content.

The source inventory, authored page/XF content and DAM references were compared directly; no closed-loop expected-payload oracle was used. All seven DAM path entries exist, six PNG originals are packaged, five are visible and Falcon is explicitly unused.

Both dialogs use declared Granite resource types and model/multifield properties match. No administrative resolver, service resolver, plaintext secret, TODO or protected DAM JCR property was detected.
The review skill is unavailable in this workspace; its required checks were performed directly with XML parsing, static searches and contract comparison.
